editorial.blurb: This viral Sichuan spot delivers authentic, deeply flavorful noodles and braises in a bright, welcoming space that's worth the wait.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive on a weekend around 1 PM when it's packed—they'll text you when your table's ready, giving you time to explore the neighborhood or hit a nearby bakery without stress.
signatureDishes: Spicy braised beef brisket hand-pulled noodle soup
